column1: # Trauma-center hospitals charged 4.4% more for non-trauma inpatient stays, and 5.2% more for non-trauma emergency visits.

# Source: Kessler, Sweeney & Melnick, Health Affairs 43(3), March 2024: commercial claims, 2012 to 2018, about 2,000 hospitals nationwide. The 4.4% is for inpatient admissions; 5.2% is for emergency department visits in the authors’ baseline model (2.7% in a sensitivity model).
